name: Supabase

repo.name: supabase
repo.description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.

node_fit.hypothesis: Supabase can support product-grade node systems needing Postgres, auth, realtime, storage, and team-facing app state.
Supabase-backed apps can expose node artifacts and state to users or teams.

evidence.note: Repository metadata shows very high adoption, active pushes, Apache-2.0 license, and Postgres/auth/realtime/storage topics.

risks: May be overkill for local-only node runs.
Hosted service, self-hosting, auth, and permission details need careful review.
Broad platform scope can hide operational complexity.
next_review_tasks: Review local development and self-hosting setup.
Design node artifact schema in Postgres.
Test auth/permission model for team handoff.
